## Actual experiment
Different from dense ribbon groom, radial geometry smoothing or vertex-color experiments: bake fine-scale reference down color into a real UV atlas with two decimation budgets, to test whether a light mobile-ready topology and phototexture can preserve detail. It does not create actual volumetric feathers. Extract source RGBA image crop rows 270:360 cols 255:335; subtract Gaussian low frequency (sigma 9,9,0), mirror tile the residual over 1024x1024, add cream [.79,.735,.65] with strengths 0,1.15,.65. Mesh +Z front, +Y crown; use cylindrical UV theta atan2(X,Z), u=theta/(2pi)+.5, v=(Y+1.01)/2.02, split triangles crossing periodic seam by duplicating low-u vertices and adding 1. Dense 512x512 original mesh maximum-radius envelope with periodic nearest-neighbor fill and Gaussian sigma 1, interpolate to atlas to estimate front X,Z. Front source sample U=.56+.46X,V=.51-.46Y; alpha=smoothstep(.28,.66,Z)*smoothstep(.07,.30,Y)*(1-smoothstep(.73,.93,Y))*source alpha. Source texture is not claimed to be measured on the back. VTK quadric decimation with volume preservation, reductions 0/.82/.90. PBR baseColorTexture 1024², roughness .95, metallic 0. All three exported and reimported actual GLB textures and UVs, then actual VTK textured 3D renders at 320x320 and 0/45/90/135/180 degrees, 15 total; offscreen returned RGB despite X-server warning. VTK preview is not a PBR/WebGL/mobile benchmark. UV seam duplicates mean indexed topology may report open seams; no new watertight/self-intersection or mobile claim.

## Visual gate
The actual 15-view sheet was viewed. 90% triangle reduction preserves the main silhouette surprisingly well and cuts file size from 6.24 MB to 1.09 MB. Fine down patch reads as flat speckled/papery surface, not soft volumetric mesoptile; the strong version is particularly grainy. Crown and side facial projection have visible abrupt darker band, eyes are still predominantly projected, wing groove remains adult-like, feet exposed and backside smooth/ovoid rather than real juvenile down. All three reject. No new phone WebGL test following art rejection. Do not confuse efficient topology with visual acceptance. Next prioritize a genuinely distinct base or new source-bound neural reconstruction rather than repeatedly polishing this geometry. No scientific claim. Main, concept, 251-species production, existing prototype and deployment untouched.
